name: Machina Dei 4

frame.name: High-Impact Frame
frame.description: Slow firing and high damage. This weapon is more accurate when stationary, moving slowly, and aiming down sights.

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.description:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: High-Caliber Rounds
perks.description:
Shots from this weapon knock the target back farther.
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

flavor:
A charnel but effulgent orb—beacon in a loathsome dark—
Fêted, fetid corpses rise—a too-long-absent gibbous spark.
